verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API with campaign report endpoints, list and contact management, and marketing claims about segmentation and send timing. Nothing documents an API or agent path to create a campaign draft, target it at a segment, or hold it for human approval before send. Read-only campaign reports and UI-level scheduling claims do not deliver the drafting-and-approval workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send
